messages:
Priya K.: FYI — ACME Finance reached out. Invoice INV-2026-0042 was paid but the PO on their AP side needs 98765, invoice has 12345 (our sales PO). They need a reissued invoice with the correct PO and a credit for the original payment so their system can match.
Sam W.: can you paste the invoice link + payment txid? I’ll check if we can do same-day credit.
Priya K.: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0042
Priya K.: Payment TXID: tx_0a9f8b3c (card). Amount: 1,240.00 USD (includes 20 USD VAT). Customer company name: ACME Holdings Inc. AP contact: ap@acme.com
payments-bot: Payment tx_0a9f8b3c captured on 2026-02-24 14:12 UTC. Status: settled.
Diego M.: if it's settled we need to issue a credit note against INV-2026-0042 then reissue a new invoice INV-2026-0045 with PO 98765. Finance needs the bookkeeping memo (why credit issued) and to know whether tax/VAT needs adjustment.
Ava L.: tagging finance: @Sam W. @Diego M. — make sure the credit note references the original TXID so we can reconcile in ledger. Also confirm whether invoice should show VAT reversed or reclassed so their AP can process.
Sam W.: understood. Quick checklist: 1) Issue credit note referencing INV-2026-0042 + tx_0a9f8b3c. 2) Reissue new invoice with PO=98765 and same line items. 3) If tax treatment changes, adjust VAT lines accordingly and notify customer. 4) Mark original invoice as "replaced" in system.
Priya K.: Customer requested an emailed credit note + PDF reissue to ap@acme.com and cc sales@acme.com. They want the documents today.
Diego M.: I'll run the credit now. Internal command:
```
# finance console
billing admin --credit --invoice INV-2026-0042 --amount 1240.00 --reason "PO mismatch / reissue" --ref tx_0a9f8b3c
```
Diego M.: Processing — creating credit note CN-2026-009.
billing-bot: Credit CN-2026-009 created for INV-2026-0042. Amount: 1,240.00 USD. Status: pending-refund.
Sam W.: note: because this was a card capture, refund to card will take 3-5 business days. For AP matching we should still send a credit note (PDF) immediately and set ledger entry "credit issued" so they can record it.
Ava L.: can we create the reissued invoice now (status = draft) so customer sees it immediately and we can finalize once refund completes?
Diego M.: yes — creating Draft INV-2026-0045 with PO field updated to 98765 and VAT line preserved. Command:
```
# create reissue draft
billing admin --reissue --from INV-2026-0042 --to INV-2026-0045 --set-po 98765 --status draft
```
billing-bot: Draft Invoice INV-2026-0045 created (PO: 98765). Amount: 1,240.00 USD. Action required: finalize & send.
Priya K.: Customer wants the final invoice to show "Applied credit CN-2026-009" and include reference to original tx_0a9f8b3c in memo. Also please add their AP reference ID: ACME-AP-7788 on the invoice header.
Sam W.: will finalize and send. One question on VAT: the original included 20 USD VAT; customer says their AP needs VAT on the reissued invoice to display as "Reverse charge" line. Accounting, is that ok retroactively?
Diego M.: we can add an additional note line stating "VAT reverse charge applied per customer request; accounting team confirmed no net change in tax liability; see memo #ACCT-2026-112." I'll attach memo in the PDF.
Ava L.: sounds good. Sam, can you send the credit note PDF + the new invoice PDF to ap@acme.com and cc sales@acme.com? Use subject: "Credit note CN-2026-009 + Reissued Invoice INV-2026-0045 (PO 98765)".
Sam W.: sending docs now. Email sent at 15:06 UTC. Attachment names: CN-2026-009.pdf, INV-2026-0045.pdf
Priya K.: ACME AP confirmed receipt and said they can match once PDFs are in their system. They asked when refund to card will post. I told them 3-5 business days.
Diego M.: refund initiated via gateway. Refund ID: rf_47b2c. payments-bot: Refund rf_47b2c issued to tx_0a9f8b3c. Expected settle: 2026-03-03.
Priya K.: customer replied: "Thanks — please include our AP reference ACME-AP-7788 on the invoice PDF. Once matched we can confirm final payment clearing." :thumbsup:
Sam W.: marked INV-2026-0042 as Replaced. Ledger notes updated: replaced_by=INV-2026-0045, credit=CN-2026-009, refund_id=rf_47b2c, original_tx=tx_0a9f8b3c.
Ava L.: closing loop — Sam, Diego, please drop a short note in the finance ticket (TKT-9421) with steps and timestamps so ops can audit.
Diego M.: done. Ticket updated: CN created, draft invoice created, refund initiated, emails sent.
Priya K.: Customer confirmed they matched the documents on their side and will confirm once refund posts. I’ll follow up in 3 business days to close.
Ava L.: thanks team. :eyes:
